brief:
Wave 3 — one package, one implementer (effort max): PlaybackSessionActor runs PlaybackReducer; PlayerViewModel becomes the presentation model.
STEP 1. ControlPlane/PlaybackSessionActor.swift — `actor PlaybackSessionActor` with `state`, `send(_ intent: PlayerIntent)`, `ingest(_ event: PlayerEvent)`; runs Effects: startSession (bridge or OfflinePlaybackBuilder, emits .session events with the bridge's identity), stopSession(expected identity), loadEngine (PlaybackEngineSession with reuse), disposeEngine, seek, replan/renewSource (bridge), runRecovery (engine session perform), pollServerHealth/schedule/cancelTimer (owns PlayerTaskRegistry's control-plane keys), reportProgress/FirstFrame/PlanExecutionStarted, publish (→ `@MainActor` presentation sink). Every effect carries LoadID/SessionIdentity and is dropped if stale when it completes. Engine events from the session's stream are stamped with its LoadID and ingested. RecoveryDriver output becomes `PlayerEvent.recovery(action, loadID)`.
STEP 2. Move LoadRequest/LoadOrigin out of PlayerViewModel into ControlPlane/LoadRequest.swift (retarget the 4 test sites).
STEP 3. PlayerViewModel: delete the control core (beginFreshLoad, runStartSession, disposeActivePlayerForFreshLoad/disposePlayerOffMain/OneShotContinuation, adoptPreparedPlayback + PlaybackAdoptionOrigin, loadStream, makeExecutionPlan (moves to the actor), attemptProtocolV3Replan/restartCurrentTranscodeHLS (→ ReplanIntent), attemptBackgroundSessionRenewal/attemptStaleSessionRenewal/attemptServerOutageRecovery/waitForServerReady/handleOriginOutageChanged/probeServerHealthOnce bodies (→ effects), finalizeTerminalPlaybackError (→ .failed + publish), handleEndOfFile control parts, commitSeek/beginReanchorSeekUI/reloadServerBackedHLSForSeek/reloadLocalLoopbackForSeekBeforeAnchor (→ .seek intent; reanchor-before-anchor becomes a ReplanIntent/loadEngine rule in the reducer), handleScenePhase (→ .scenePhase intent), suspendForBackground/resumeSuspendedPlayback (→ reducer), the identity fields (activePlaybackSessionId, staleSessionRecoverySessionId, backgroundRenewalSessionId, activeServerOutageRecoverySessionId, streamLoadGeneration, freshLoadGeneration, serverOutageRecoveryGeneration, hasAttempted*, hasReachedEndOfFile → `.ended`, playbackInterruption, suspendedPlayback, sourceOutageActive/NoticeShown, seek-filter triple, isDisposed → `.disposed`). Keep: every member in inventory-4 B.2 with the same name (as projections of Presentation or as intent forwarders), NowPlaying/Next-Up/markers/sleep timer/controls/scrub/hold-seek/notices/settings glue, the realtime client + SiloControl projection (makeSiloControlPlaybackState reads Presentation), the AVAudioSession route observer (forwards `.outputRouteChanged`), the track coordinator (ports now read actor state snapshots and send `.selectTrack`/replan intents).
STEP 4. NowPlaying handlers and SiloControl commands → intents (`.play/.pause/.seek`).
STEP 5. PlaybackSessionActorTests over FakePlaybackBackend + FakePlaybackTransport (fresh load; in-place replan reuse; stale event ignored; second replan dropped; background renewal; outage ride-through + kick; scene-phase tables; suspend/resume; dispose cancels timers; progress reporting cadence). Full suite. Hardware validation gate (§6) recorded before merge.
invariants: All 130 view-facing members in inventory-4 B.2 keep their names and semantics; no view file changes
